Name: Buffs Crops
Author: Wandox99
Description:
Hello everyone!
This mod adds Buffs Crops to the game, these crops give powerfull buffs when you eat them.
The crops are:

Energy Root:
Give 500 max energy;
Seed price: 1000;
Sell price: 1350.

Magnetic Fruit: (Regrow)
Give 500 Magnetism;
Seed price: 250;
Sell price: 200.

Radioactive Parsnip:
Give +10 farming skill;
Seed price: 4000;
Sell price: 5000.

Radioactive Onion:
Give + foraging skill;
Seed price: 250;
Sell price: 350.

Pick-Axe Flower:
Give +10 foraging and mining skill;
Seed price: 400;
Sell price: 600.

Strange Bulb:
Give  +10 attack;
Seed price: 10000;
Sell price: 15000.

Ocean Starfruit: (Regrow)
Give +10 fishing skill;
Seed price: 4000;
Sell price:  750.

Persian Shield:
Give +10 defense;
Seed price: 350;
Sell price: 500.

Speedy Bean: (Regrow)
Give +10 speed;
Seed price: 900;
Sell price: 1100.

Four-leaf Clover: (Regrow)
Give +10 luck;
Seed price: 25000;
Sell price: 100,

Snapdragon Skull:
Give +1 speed, +10 mining & attack & defense & luck;
Seed price: 50000;
Sell price: 3000,

The seeds are selled by Pierre's shop once you entered the Qi's Walnut Room.
The buffs cannot be added together: if you have Persian Shield's buff and eat the Strange Bulb the defense buff will replaced with Attack buff (it's how work in Vanilla).
The duration of the buff lasts long enough throughout the day, perhaps even too long.

[size=5]Install[/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url].
3. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.



[size=4]If you liked the mod, please leave an endorsement![/size]



If you have suggestion or feedback feel free to write me on the [url=http://discord.gg/stardewvalley]official Discord server[/url] with the tag @Wandox#6064 in the modmaking channels
